brief.headline: Sentinel repo attached; first hardening PR shipped. JARVIS command HUD deployed.

items.text: Sentinel repo attached and mapped: authorization-first Go security CLI, 131 Go files, build/vet/tests/lint all green at baseline.
Shipped PR #2 — hardened all 9 intrusive-tool output parsers against hostile input; caught and fixed a hashcat parser bug that fabricated 'hash recovered' findings from status banners.
JARVIS personal command HUD built and deployed — voice loop, reactive orb, panels, agent roster, state pipeline (PR #1).
AEGIS OVERWATCH review fixes shipped: pinch ghost-tap guard, theme-complete chrome, brightened sat feed, longer impact FX.
Sentinel next milestone needs your steer — see the proposed direction in Operations.

priorities.label: SENTINEL DEVELOPMENT
priorities.next: Parser-hardening PR #2 in review. Next: extend the robustness pattern to the authz/scope gate and audit-chain, or take a milestone you name.

tasks.title: Sentinel PR #2 — review + merge parser hardening
tasks.note: Tests + one defensive fix. CI (Build/Test/Lint) running; all three pass locally.

tasks.title: Sentinel: pick the next milestone
tasks.note: Proposed: central authorization-contract fuzzing + audit-chain tamper tests. Your call in Operations.

tasks.title: AEGIS: record 2-min cinematic capture for the pitch
Configure ElevenLabs key for authentic JARVIS voice
tasks.note: Settings panel → key + voice ID. Falls back to en-GB system voice.

tasks.title: Fill in values.md + business.md knowledge base
tasks.note: jarvis/knowledge/ — the team checks decisions against it; blanks force escalations.

roadblocks.title: Sentinel CI Lint is broken on main (pre-existing)
roadblocks.impact: Every PR's Lint check fails; Build + Test are green. Not caused by PR #2.
roadblocks.proposed: golangci-lint v2.1.6 can't parse the Go 1.26 stdlib that `go-version: stable` now pulls. Bump golangci-lint or pin go-version to 1.25 in ci.yml — a small separate PR I can open on your go-ahead.

roadblocks.title: Sentinel next milestone needs direction
roadblocks.impact: The team can keep hardening autonomously, but a named milestone focuses P0.
roadblocks.proposed: Approve the proposed track — fuzz the central authorization contract shared by active adapters and add tamper tests for the hash-chained audit log — or name your own.

roadblocks.title: No ElevenLabs credentials
roadblocks.impact: JARVIS speaks with the system en-GB voice instead of the cinematic one.
roadblocks.proposed: Paste key + voice ID in Settings (stored in this browser only).

roadblocks.title: Knowledge base is placeholder-only
roadblocks.impact: Decisions that aren't covered by values.md get escalated instead of resolved.
roadblocks.proposed: Fill in jarvis/knowledge/values.md and business.md when you have a moment.
